items.title: SNDR Shares Decline 4.1% Since Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
items.summary: Schneider National's Q3 2026 earnings surge 141.7% on stronger pricing and cost cuts, prompting a higher outlook despite a 4.1% stock decline since the release.

items.summary: Canadian National's Q3 2026 earnings beat estimates as broad-based freight growth and productivity gains lift revenues, despite rising fuel costs and margin pressure.
